title: Turn on two-factor authentication
text: Add a second login step to your email and banking accounts. It blocks most password-theft attacks even when your password leaks.

title: Follow the 3-2-1 backup rule
text: Keep 3 copies of important files, on 2 different types of storage, with 1 copy off-site or in the cloud.

title: Place your router in the open
text: Wi-Fi works best from a central, raised spot away from microwaves, metal cabinets and thick walls.

title: Restart weekly, update monthly
text: A weekly restart clears memory leaks, and monthly updates close security holes that slow machines are often hiding.

title: Spot a phishing email
text: Check the sender address, hover over links before clicking, and be suspicious of anything urgent that asks for a password or payment.

title: Test your restore
text: A backup you have never restored is only a hope. Open a few backed-up files every quarter to confirm they work.
